_about: The Economics Handbook Collection: the public catalogue. Every title, page count, part and syllabus-map row is taken from the volume itself (its title page, contents page and syllabus map). The handbooks are never stored in this repository; tools/upsc/build_upsc.py renders the few watermarked preview pages from a private folder. Price: ₹99 per volume; no bundle price.
